items.title: Bill Allred interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 24, 2017
items.q: He said I want a band like Lawrence Welk.

ctx.x: Do you really need the bass player!

Yeah I’ve gotten that question. Well he said, “How many in that band?” I said, “There’s eight of us.” He said no, no, no. He said I want a band like Lawrence Welk. He says, “I want all the saxophones.” He said, “I want the same instrumentation. I want all the horns,” he said, “but I want a guy singer and a girl singer and I gotta have a guitar player.” And I’m doing some mental stuff. And he gets done with all that and I said, “Well Johnny” Johnny was his — “Johnny I said, the price I gave you was for eight guys,…

That’s a good story. I’ve had occasion where I’ll give a price for a trio and then I’ll kick myself because the person will go, “Is that per man?” And that’s not what I meant, but well yes. It’s a little too late to do that.
